correctness.rationale: Two ones imply no factor containing a one of length >=2 qualifies, while the one-letter factor 1 always qualifies; all remaining factors are zero powers with exact occurrences sum(g-j+1)_+. An exact monotone cutoff gives sharp balanced and concentrated extrema. Uniform compositions converge to Dirichlet(1,1,1), root comparison is uniformly O(1/N), ordered simplex slices give the atom and densities, and exact rational integration yields moments. Standalone independent literal enumeration checked 1140 complete gap triples and root/moment computations checked stated cases; finite computations supplement the complete analytic proof.
